title: Friday tacos
setting: Maya and Chris are making a Friday-night plan. Same familiar world as the slower diagnostic, but at a natural conversational clip with common reductions.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, I do. I was gonna say the same thing. You have a place in mind?
lines.spoken: Yeah, I do. I was gonna say the same thing. You have a place in mind?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Not really. I don't wanna do anything fancy. I just wanna sit and talk and eat something.
lines.spoken: Not really. I don't wanna do anything fancy. I just wanna sit and talk and eat something.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: We could do that taco place. Or the noodle place, if you want something warm.
lines.spoken: We could do that taco place. Or the noodle place, if you want something warm.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Tacos sound good. You wanna just go after work?
lines.spoken: Tacos sound good. You wanna just go after work?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I can do after work, but I might be a little late. Like, I gotta finish something. Give me 'til seven.
lines.spoken: I can do after work, but I might be a little late. Like, I gotta finish something. Gimme 'til seven.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Seven is fine. You wanna meet there, or you wanna come get me?
lines.spoken: Seven is fine. You wanna meet there, or you wanna come get me?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'll meet you there. It's closer to you anyway.
lines.spoken: I'll meet you there. It's closer to you anyway.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. If it's packed, just text me and we'll figure it out.
lines.spoken: Okay. If it's packed, just text me and we'll figure it out.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. I'm pretty sure we can get a table. It's not that kind of place.
lines.spoken: Yeah. I'm pretty sure we can get a table. It's not that kind of place.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good. I don't have the energy to wait an hour.
lines.spoken: Good. I don't have the energy to wait an hour.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Done. Don't leave work at seven.
lines.spoken: Done. Don't leave work at seven.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm never gonna live that down, am I.
lines.spoken: I'm never gonna live that down, am I.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: No. I'll get a table if I get there first.
lines.spoken: No. I'll get a table if I get there first.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Please do. I'll text you when I'm on my way.
lines.spoken: Please do. I'll text you when I'm on my way.

gist.askEn: What are they doing on Friday?

gist.askZh: 这是一场很正式的约会吗？他们想要怎样的晚上？
gist.askEn: Is this a fancy night out? What do they want?

details.askZh: 他们约在几点？怎么见面？
details.askEn: What time do they set, and how will they meet?
accept: Chris might be a little late

details.askZh: 如果店里人多怎么办？Chris 出发时会怎样？
details.askEn: What if the place is packed, and what will Chris do when he leaves?
accept: he'll text when he's on his way

glue.noteZh: 和 120 那段里的 want to 对照：这里已经缩成 wanna，夹在 You 和 do 中间。
glue.standard: You want to do something Friday

glue.noteZh: have got to / have to 在口语里常说成 gotta。这是中等语速里很常见的缩减。
glue.standard: I have got to finish something

glue.noteZh: on my way 三个词很快，on my 都弱。后面正式练习里会反复出现。
glue.standard: when I am on my way

chunks.form: You wanna just go after work?
chunks.sayAfter: Tacos sound good. You wanna just go after work?

chunks.form: I'll text you when I'm on my way.
chunks.meaningZh: 我出发了再给你发消息。
chunks.sayAfter: Please do. I'll text you when I'm on my way.

roleplay.setupZh: 你想约朋友周五随便吃一顿，不要太正式。商量地点、时间和怎么会合，并说好如果人多或会晚到就发消息。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, easygoing. He may need until seven because of work. He prefers to meet there. He will joke if you remind him not to leave work at seven.
variants: They pick the noodle place instead.
The taco place might be packed.
mustUse: You wanna just go after work
starters: I don't wanna do anything fancy.

fluency.promptZh: 把周五的计划讲清楚：去哪、几点、谁先到、晚到或人多时怎么联系。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the Friday plan: where, what time, who arrives first, and how they'll handle a late arrival or a packed room. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
